### Checklist

- [x] I searched related issues but found no solution.
- [x] The bug persists in the latest version.
- [x] Issues without environment info and a minimal reproducible demo are hard to resolve and may receive no feedback.
- [x] If this is not a bug report but a general question, please start a discussion at https://github.com/sglang/sglang/discussions. Otherwise, it will be closed.
- [x] Please use English. Otherwise, it will be closed.

### Describe the bug

GLM-5.3-Flash fused MLA weight loading can retain a RunAI Model Streamer view after the current streamed tensor has been consumed. The model loader caches `q_a_proj` and `kv_a_proj_with_mqa` shards before concatenating them into `fused_qkv_a_proj_with_mqa`. With distributed RunAI streaming, both views can point into a staging buffer that is reused for a later tensor, so the cached q shard may be overwritten before the kv shard arrives.

This can cause intermittent corrupted fused MLA weights and malformed or incorrect generated output. The same `Glm5NextForConditionalGeneration.load_weights` path is used when DFLASH loads the draft model, so the draft model can be affected as well.

### Reproduction

Production-style configuration:

```bash
python3 -m sglang.launch_server \
  --model-path <GLM-5.3-Flash-FP8-checkpoint> \
  --load-format runai_streamer \
  --tensor-parallel-size 8 \
  --speculative-algorithm DFLASH \
  --speculative-draft-model-path <GLM-5.3-Flash-draft-checkpoint>
```

The issue is reproducible with a deterministic synthetic iterator:

1. Create a q view backed by a reusable staging buffer and mark it with the RunAI streamer tensor attribute.
2. Yield `model.layers.0.self_attn.q_a_proj.weight`.
3. Overwrite the staging buffer and yield `model.layers.0.self_attn.kv_a_proj_with_mqa.weight`.
4. Concatenate the cached views.

Without an ownership copy, the fused result contains the overwritten q values. The regression test in the attached PR verifies that the original q values are retained.

### Environment

```text
SGLang: xinyuan/glm-5.3-flash-support (latest tested commit)
Model: GLM-5.3-Flash FP8
Load format: runai_streamer
Deployment: Kubernetes with distributed RunAI Model Streamer
Tensor parallelism: TP=8
Streamer concurrency: 8
Draft model: DFLASH, loaded through the same GLM5 load_weights implementation
```
title: [Bug] GLM-5.3-Flash RunAI streaming can corrupt fused MLA weights
